resume: MNM-1 is a six-track monophonic synth, each track with its own synthesis or effect machine, pages of eight knobs, a high-pass and low-pass filter, a tape delay and three LFOs, parameter locks and slides. Derived from Hortator, with sounds taken from MONO2K.

commandes.role: With KEYS on (SEL), keyboard octave down. On STEP, the previous bank of 16 steps. Held in LOCK: turning a knob clears only its lock; tapped, clears the held step's locks on release.
With KEYS on, octave up. On STEP, the next bank of 16 steps.
EFFECTS, SLICER, REVERB, CHORUS, LOFI (calibrated tracks also have DESTROY and MOD FX). Held: PERFORM, the master effects live.
Called SCL: KEYS on or off, the keys play the selected track (on at startup).
SYNTH (the machine's eight knobs), then AMP, then TRACK (MODEL, NOTE, OUT, IN, GATE, sends). Again: the next row or page. Held: the preset list.
Tapped: global settings. Held: the white keys mute the tracks.
Tapped: TRACKS (levels, lengths, pans) or HOME (the oscilloscope; SELECT leads to COMP). Held: the menu.
Patterns (save, load, name), tools and KIT slots.
The ARP, then ARP MODE, ARP TRIG and ARP RHYTHM.
STEP, PATTERN, MOTION, SONG, SWING MASK and TRANSPOSE. Leaves LOCK mode.
Arms recording; on STEP, when stopped, KEYS on: step recording. During playback, turning knobs records locks.
On eight-knob pages, the track's machine; elsewhere, the pages; on TRACKS, the tempo. A held step: its trigger type.
With KEYS, play the selected track. On STEP: a step on or off; with a step held, KNOB 1 its probability, KNOB 2 its ratchets, KNOB 3 its accent, KNOB 4 SLIDE. GLO held: mute the tracks.

gestes: A step held + EDIT, ENV, FX or LFO: LOCK mode, the page opens and the keys stay as steps; hold a step and turn a knob to lock the value on that step.

modes.texte: Two rows of four on the FM-1's four knobs: KNOB 1 to 4 set the lit row. SYNTH, AMP (ATK HOLD DEC REL, DIST LVL PAN PORT), FILTER (BASE WDTH HPQ LPQ, ATK DEC BOFS WOFS), EFFECTS, LFO 1 to 3.
A lock lasts until the next trigger; up to 240 per project, recorded live or set in LOCK mode. Slide glides the value to the next lock.

a_savoir: MIDI: channels 1 to 6 play the matching calibrated track; clock and MIDI over USB and TRS, MIDI LEARN.
